name: Generic Art-Net
notes: Complete list: 4 actions (src/actions.ts) and 1 value feedback (src/feedbacks.ts).

Sends ArtDmx (OpOutput 0x5000) packets over UDP to port 6454 for one universe and one receiver IP per connection (src/artnet.ts). The universe (0-32767), receiver IP (unicast or broadcast), slow update interval (default 1000 ms, min 10) and fade update interval (default 40 ms, min 5) are config fields (src/config.ts), not action options. Several universes need several connections.

Channels are 1-based (1-512). Values are 0-255; numeric DMX values are rounded and clamped to 0-255 when sent (toDmxValue). The number fields of the module use clampValues (not part of the schema): Companion clamps the value to min/max.

set_complex: text of groups 'channel,value;' where the channel may be a range such as '1-20' (regex /^(\d+)(?:\s*-\s*(\d+))?$/ in parseChannelSpec). Invalid groups are logged as an error and nothing is set. Values are not range-checked by the parser; transitions.run clamps them to 0-255 (src/transitions.ts:72).

set_consecutive: comma separated values, first value goes on the start channel. A value list that does not parse sets nothing. Channels beyond 512 are not checked in the action; transitions.run ignores a channel without a current value (src/transitions.ts:59-64).
offset: adds the value change (-255 to 255) to the current value of the channel and clamps the result to 0-255.
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.1.3: options support expressions. useVariables is set on the two text inputs; Companion resolves variables before the callback (comment in src/actions.ts).

options.label: Channel (Range 1-512), Value (Range 0-255);
options.description:
Use a range to set multiple channels to the same value, eg 1-20,127;30,255;
Tooltip: Each parameter should be separated by a comma (,) and each group of parameters should be separated by a semicolon (;)

actions.name: Set Consecutive Values
actions.description: Set a run of channels, starting from the given channel. Useful for fixtures with multiple channels

options.label: Values (Range 0-255)
options.description:
eg 255,100,0 sets the start channel to 255, the next channel to 100 and the one after to 0
Tooltip: Each value should be separated by a comma (,). The first value is set on the start channel

feedbacks.name: Channel Value
feedbacks.description: The value currently being sent for a channel. Store this in a local variable to show it on a button
